AND o.organization_code ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{organizationCode}, '%')

SELECT parent.organization_code, parent.organization_name, parent.organization_type, parent.use_status, NULL AS current_parent_organization_code FROM organization_relation_history relation JOIN organization parent ON parent.organization_code = relation.parent_organization_code WHERE relation.organization_code = #{organizationCode} AND relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation.effective_start_date <= #{onDate} AND (relation.effective_end_date IS NULL OR relation.effective_end_date >= #{onDate}) ORDER BY relation.effective_start_date DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT child.organization_code, child.organization_name, child.organization_type, child.use_status, #{parentOrganizationCode} AS current_parent_organization_code FROM organization_relation_history relation JOIN organization child ON child.organization_code = relation.organization_code WHERE relation.parent_organization_code = #{parentOrganizationCode} AND relation.status = 'ACTIVE' AND relation.effective_start_date <= #{onDate} AND (relation.effective_end_date IS NULL OR relation.effective_end_date >= #{onDate}) ORDER BY child.organization_code

SELECT organization_relation_history_id, organization_code, parent_organization_code, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status FROM organization_relation_history WHERE organization_code = #{organizationCode} ORDER BY effective_start_date

SELECT organization_relation_history_id, organization_code, parent_organization_code, effective_start_date, effective_end_date, status FROM organization_relation_history WHERE organization_code = #{organizationCode} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND effective_start_date <= #{onDate} AND (effective_end_date IS NULL OR effective_end_date >= #{onDate}) ORDER BY effective_start_date DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE organization_relation_history SET effective_end_date = #{effectiveEndDate}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE organization_relation_history_id = #{relationId}
